newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen down on retail selling.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen down on retail selling.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange are likely to drop on Tuesday on continued selling by mostly retail investors, brokers said.
"Retail selling may continue. Investors are seeking cash to pay off bank loans before the end of the financial year," said broker Khurshid Alam. The financial year ends on June 30.
On Monday the benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) lost 13.71 points or 1.24 percent to close at 1,091.7 on a turnover of 52.2 million taka.
